description:
Check a website started with create_website or a logo started with regenerate_website_logo. Each call waits up to about 10 seconds, so it is safe to call back-to-back. Keep calling while stop_polling is false.

stage is one of: 'building', 'connecting' (published, domain and SSL being set up), 'live' (give the user live_url), 'private_preview' (ready; only the owner can open preview_url), 'needs_attention' (show message: the owner finishes in the editor), 'failed' (show message; create_website can be retried unless declined is set), or 'not_found'. sections lists what the site contains, so you can tell the user what was left out and that edit_url is where to add it.

wait_seconds.description: How long the server may wait while building.

name: get_website_status

logo_state.description: updating, done or failed, after regenerate_website_logo.

title: Get website status
